input: Owner: output to most platforms (Substack, IG, FB, Threads, X, TikTok, YouTube, email, search, AI providers) with measurement of what does best; then: AI content creation for all platforms from interviews, for this repo and for businesses/individuals.
errors: First push failed portfolio-validate: new workflow distribute-hub.yml missing from platform/ci/publish-surface.yaml (fixed with publish_surface.py --write).

doc_friction.issue: The verify checklist does not mention that adding any workflow requires publish_surface.py --write; found only when CI went red.
Running its validate job locally is hard: multi-line run blocks, a shallow-clone base fetch and a >5 min marketing suite; no one-command local runner for this job.

deviations.why: X listed as an owner-suggested automated channel; built as drafts-only because the X API became pay-per-use for new developers on 2026-02-06 and the same spec forbids paid channels.

notes: Shipped (1) platform/distribution/hub.mjs: 18-platform registry with mode+reason, per-platform composer with rotating copy templates, live adapters for Threads/Facebook/Instagram/Buttondown (off by default, not exercised against live accounts), drafts for X/LinkedIn/Substack/Medium/TikTok/YouTube/Reddit/HN, scoreboard joining platform metrics with ?ref= arrivals (shrinkage, min 5 posts); 12 new counter ref tags; distribute-hub.yml (dry run, artifact only). (2) ventures/interview-content-studio, built by a subagent: interview -> per-platform cadence -> 4-week calendar -> drafts, no-key template engine plus BYOK AI with a no-invented-numbers validator. Checks: node --test platform/distribution + counter 155/155; privacy 94/94 after bumping the opt-out switch count; venture 40/40; validate_workflows ok; publish_surface --check ok; check_venture_regression OK vs origin/main. Pre-existing on main, not this PR: activecampaign-import-csv-check hypothesis lacks evidence (router validate.py and test_allocate fail). Later in the run: merged main twice; carried two fixes for main breakage (setup-python in portfolio-pages.yml; daily/build.mjs in the publish-branch test stub); added the report and handoff portfolio/distribution/hub-report-2026-10-20.md and the post docs/posts/2026-10-20-one-tool-for-every-platform-what-the-apis-allow.md at the owner's request.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: estimate: ~10 h for the hub (registry research, 4 API adapters, metrics, tests) and ~14 h for a tested product page with an AI path

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
